description: Register a BigQueryDdlResource (dataset/table lifecycle + scalar value-check actions) for use by other components

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

credentials_path.label: Credentials Path
credentials_path.description: Path to a service-account JSON file.

credentials_env_var.label: Credentials Env Var
credentials_env_var.description: Env var containing the service-account JSON as a string (same convention as bigquery_resource's/dataproc_resource's gcp_credentials_env_var). Checked after credentials and credentials_path; falls back to GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS if none of the three are set.

project_id.label: Project Id
project_id.description: GCP project. Defaults to the service account's own project.

location.label: Location
location.description: Default BigQuery location, e.g. 'US' or 'EU'. Can be overridden per ensure_dataset() call.

name: BigQuery Ddl Resource
